projectKey.title: Project Key
projectKey.description: Certinia PSA project name, project id, project code, or Salesforce record id. Used only to find the project.

projectName.title: Project Name
projectName.description: Optional Certinia PSA project name. Used only to find the project and not sent to the external AI API.

projectCode.title: Project Code
projectCode.description: Optional Certinia PSA project id or code. Used only to find the project and not sent to the external AI API.

projectId.title: Project Id
projectId.description: Optional Certinia PSA project id or Salesforce project record id.

requestId.title: Request Id
requestId.description: Optional safe correlation id for backend telemetry. Do not use Salesforce record ids.
